purpose: Represent recurring or persistent Starfleet/Federation operational responsibilities that can generate tasking without a crisis event.
rules: Standing requirements create routine operational needs only when their cadence, coverage or live state says work is due.
They do not guarantee that the player receives the resulting mission.
War, emergency, ship losses, treaty changes or resource shortages can alter or suspend normal requirements.
Routine duty remains meaningful even when no crisis exists.
Requirement schedules are campaign state, not a mechanism for replaying future canon.
